visualCharacteristics.purpose: Boxed promo text (eyebrow, heading, paragraph, CTA) beside an edge-to-edge image; dark option renders a full-bleed navy band
visualCharacteristics.description: Side-by-side text and image layout. Side-by-side text and image layout; eyebrow kept as a paragraph, not a heading.

contentPattern.description: Text panel (H3 'Global Market Outlook' + paragraph + CTA 'Read the latest report') beside photo 'Sailboat' | Eyebrow 'Market volatility resources' + H3 'Are you prepared for the next downside market swing?' + paragraph + CTA 'Managing market volatility', beside photo 'A man holding his surfing board walking towards the sea'
contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: text cell (optional eyebrow paragraph, H3, paragraph, CTA link) and image cell, in either order
rows: Text: optional eyebrow, H3, paragraph, CTA link

usage: Report or resource promos pairing a short pitch and CTA with a photo.
reuseGuidance: Use when one text panel sits beside one image. Put the image cell first to place it on the left. Use the dark option for the full-bleed navy band treatment.
